backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the e-commerce backend, defining types and CRUD operations for products, orders, and user profiles, along with Stripe/Razorpay config, access control, and blob storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping completed feature IDs (primarily brand rename from 'Veda Botanics' to 'Nature Glow' across various frontend files) to their affected files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON object containing one-to-two sentence summaries of each frontend source file, serving as a reference document for the frontend codebase structure and component responsibilities.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes, covering background, foreground, card, sidebar, and chart color tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML shell for the React app with the page title set to 'Nature Glow – Pure Ayurvedic Skincare', Google Fonts preconnect links, and the Razorpay checkout script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React app file that sets up TanStack Router with customer layout routes (home, shop, product detail, checkout, payment) and protected admin routes (products, orders, settings) wrapped in AdminAuthGuard and AdminLayout.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminAuthG: Route guard that redirects unauthenticated or non-admin users to the admin login page while showing a loading spinner during auth checks.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminLayou: Admin shell layout with a collapsible sidebar (desktop and mobile) containing navigation links for Products, Orders, and Settings, plus a sign-out button.
frontend/src/components/admin/OrderDetai: Modal dialog showing full order details (customer info, shipping address, items) with a dropdown to update the fulfillment status.
frontend/src/components/admin/ProductFor: A modal dialog component for creating and editing products, with form fields for name, category, price, stock, image, status, and dynamic key-value specifications, using React Query mutations to persist changes.
frontend/src/components/CartDrawer.tsx: Slide-out cart drawer component displaying cart items with quantity controls and remove buttons, a total amount summary, and a checkout navigation button.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site footer with brand info, quick navigation links, contact details, and a copyright line with a caffeine.ai attribution.
A slide-in mobile navigation drawer with Home/Shop links and an admin login/logout button, controlled by open/close props.
frontend/src/components/Navbar.tsx: Sticky top navigation bar with logo, desktop nav links, a cart icon with item count badge, and an inline mobile nav toggle.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Displays a product card with image, category, name, price, status badges (out of stock, launching soon, featured), and an add-to-cart button.
frontend/src/components/SeedProducts.tsx: Invisible component that seeds the backend with sample products when the product list is empty on mount.
frontend/src/context/CartContext.tsx: Provides a React context for cart state using Product objects with bigint IDs, supporting add, remove, update quantity, and clear operations, with an open/close drawer state.
frontend/src/contexts/CartContext.tsx: An alternative cart context implementation that persists cart items (identified by string productId) to sessionStorage and exposes add, remove, update, and clear operations along with cart open/close state.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor via React Query, initializing it with the current Internet Identity and an optional admin token, and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity authentication provider and hook using DFINITY's AuthClient, managing login status, identity persistence, and delegation validity checks.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend operations including products, orders, user profiles, site settings, and Stripe configuration, wrapping actor calls with query/mutation patterns and cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that configures Tailwind, imports Google Fonts (Playfair Display and Inter), and defines CSS custom properties for both the customer storefront (botanical green) and admin panel (slate/neutral) color palettes in light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminLogin.tsx: Admin login page that authenticates via Internet Identity, checks admin privileges, and redirects to the admin dashboard or shows an access-denied message accordingly.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminOrders.tsx: Admin page for viewing and managing customer orders, displaying stats (total, paid, pending, revenue) and a searchable/filterable orders table with payment and fulfillment status badges and an order detail modal.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminProducts.t: Admin page for managing products with search, stats summary, and a table supporting create, edit, and delete operations via a form modal and confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminSettings.t: Admin settings page that allows configuring the Razorpay Key ID, loading existing settings and saving updates via a form with success/error feedback.
frontend/src/pages/Checkout.tsx: Checkout page that collects shipping details via a form and initiates a Stripe payment session using cart items, redirecting the user to the Stripe-hosted checkout URL on success.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Landing page displaying a hero banner, feature highlights, and featured/all product sections using data fetched via React Query hooks.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailure.tsx: Static page shown after a failed payment, offering buttons to retry checkout or return to the shop.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccess.tsx: Static confirmation page displayed after a successful payment, thanking the user and providing links to continue shopping or go home.
frontend/src/pages/ProductDetail.tsx: Product detail page that fetches a single product by ID, displays its image, description, price, and stock status, and allows adding it to the cart.
frontend/src/pages/Shop.tsx: Shop listing page with search, category, and status filters that reactively narrow down products fetched from the backend and renders them as product cards.
frontend/src/utils/formatters.ts: Utility functions to format numbers as Indian Rupee currency strings and to convert Motoko nanosecond timestamps into human-readable dates.
frontend/src/utils/seedProducts.ts: Exports a static array of sample ProductInput objects (Ubtan, Neem, Sandalwood, etc.) used to seed the product catalog with predefined data.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom color tokens (including admin-specific variables), fonts, shadows, border radii, and accordion animations, plus typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks the project state for an e-commerce storefront and admin dashboard being rebranded from 'Veda Botanics' to 'Nature Glow', listing completed and pending rebranding features across frontend components.
